edges.description: During [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0007), [ccf32](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1043) was used to collect data.(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries decoded a Base64-encoded ZIP archive using the built-in [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160).(Citation: CERT Polska)

During [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0004), threat actors used [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194)'s `Invoke-ReflectivePEInjection` module.(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)

During the [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0007) campaign, the [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1044) backdoor was used to execute multiple components and exfiltrate files.(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [netstat](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0104) to identify specific ports.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
(Citation: Cisco Talos Avos Jun 2022)
(Citation: Cylance Dust Storm)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [BloodHound](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0521) discover trust between domains.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)

During [Operation Digital Eye](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0061), threat actors used [Ping](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0097) for reconnaissance.(Citation: sentinelone operationDigitalEye Dec 2024)
(Citation: Mandiant UNC3890 Aug 2022)
(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)
During [Night Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0002), threat actors used [gsecdump](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0008) to dump account hashes.(Citation: McAfee Night Dragon)
(Citation: Cybereason OperationCuckooBees May 2022)

[Indian Critical Infrastructure Intrusions](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0043) included the use of [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144) to enable remote access.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2022)
[Operation Honeybee](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0006) included the use of an upgraded version of [SYSCON](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0464).(Citation: McAfee Honeybee)
(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

During [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060), [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) used [ROAMINGHOUSE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9026).(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha Anel NOV 2024)

During [C0018](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0018), the threat actors used [netsh](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0108) on a domain controller to ensure there was no existing firewall or to disable one.(Citation: Costa AvosLocker May 2022)
(Citation: MSTIC NOBELIUM Mar 2021)
(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
During [Night Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0002), threat actors deployed [ASPXSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0073) on compromised web servers.(Citation: McAfee Night Dragon)

During [C0018](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0018), the threat actors used a PowerShell script to execute [Ping](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0097) commands once every minute against a domain controller.(Citation: Costa AvosLocker May 2022)

[Line Dancer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1186) is uniquely associated with the [ArcaneDoor](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0046) campaign.(Citation: CCCS ArcaneDoor 2024)(Citation: Cisco ArcaneDoor 2024)

During [Night Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0002), threat actors used [zwShell](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0350) to generate Trojan variants, control victim machines, and exfiltrate data.(Citation: McAfee Night Dragon)

[Line Runner](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1188) was used during the [ArcaneDoor](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0046) campaign.(Citation: CCCS ArcaneDoor 2024)(Citation: Cisco ArcaneDoor 2024)
(Citation: Cylance Dust Storm)
(Citation: Booz Allen Hamilton)
(Citation: Cylance Dust Storm)
(Citation: Lumen J-Magic JAN 2025)
(Citation: DFIR Conti Bazar Nov 2021)

[Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) used similar installation techniques with DLL sideloading to install [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) during [RedDelta Modified PlugX Infection Chain Operations](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0047).(Citation: Recorded Future RedDelta 2025)
(Citation: DFIR Conti Bazar Nov 2021)

During [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060), [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) used [HiddenFace](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9023).(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha Anel NOV 2024)(Citation: ESET MirrorFace 2025)

For [Operation Ghost](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0023), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) used [FatDuke](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0512) as a third-stage backdoor.(Citation: ESET Dukes October 2019)
[FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has routed traffic through a customized [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) relay network layer.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) with the `privilege::debug` and `lsadump::dcsync /all` flags to dump account credentials.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
(Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge January 2024)(Citation: Volexity Ivanti Zero-Day Exploitation January 2024)(Citation: Volexity Ivanti Global Exploitation January 2024)
During [Frankenstein](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0001) the threat actors used [Empire](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0363) for discovery.(Citation: Talos Frankenstein June 2019)

[REPTILE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1219) was used for command execution and persistence during [RedPenguin](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0056).(Citation: Mandiant UNC3886 Juniper Routers MAR 2025)
(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

During [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors re-registered expired [ANDROMEDA](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1074) domains to profile past victims for further targeting.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)
(Citation: Microsoft Albanian Government Attacks September 2022)
(Citation: Microsoft Deep Dive Solorigate January 2021)(Citation: CheckPoint Sunburst & Teardrop December 2020)(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020)
(Citation: Mandiant ROADSWEEP August 2022)

[VersaMem](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1154) was used during [Versa Director Zero Day Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0039) by [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017).(Citation: Lumen Versa 2024)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) exit nodes to execute commands.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)

[APT41 DUST](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0040) used [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160) to load and execute [DUSTPAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1158).(Citation: Google Cloud APT41 2024)
(Citation: Cylance Dust Storm)
(Citation: MSTIC NOBELIUM Mar 2021)
(Citation: CISA Iran Albanian Attacks September 2022)(Citation: Microsoft Albanian Government Attacks September 2022)
(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

During [Operation MidnightEclipse](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0048), threat actors made multiple attempts to install [UPSTYLE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1164)(Citation: Volexity UPSTYLE 2024)(Citation: Palo Alto MidnightEclipse APR 2024)

During [C0027](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0027), [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) used [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) for lateral movement.(Citation: Crowdstrike TELCO BPO Campaign December 2022)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [Wevtutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0645) to delete system and security event logs with `wevtutil cl system` and `wevtutil cl security`.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
(Citation: Cylance Dust Storm)
(Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge Part 3 February 2024)
[DUSTTRAP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1159) was used during [APT41 DUST](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0040).(Citation: Google Cloud APT41 2024)
[Quad7 Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0055).(Citation: Microsoft Storm-0940)
[Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) was used during [APT41 DUST](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0040).(Citation: Google Cloud APT41 2024)

During [Operation Dream Job](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0022), [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) used [Torisma](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0678) to actively monitor for new drives and remote desktop connections on an infected system.(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Jul 2020)(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Nov 2020)

During [C0017](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0017), [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used the DUSTPAN in-memory dropper to drop a [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) BEACON backdoor onto a compromised network.(Citation: Mandiant APT41)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used the [Rubeus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1071) tool to forge a Diamond Ticket that is a modified legitimate Kerberos ticket.(Citation: CERT Polska)(Citation: ESET DynoWiper Update JAN 2026)

[Indian Critical Infrastructure Intrusions](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0043) included the use of [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) malware for operations.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2022)(Citation: Dragos YIR 2021)

During [Operation Digital Eye](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0061), threat actors used custom implementations of [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002).(Citation: sentinelone operationDigitalEye Dec 2024)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) to execute programs on target machines.(Citation: CERT Polska)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194)’s `Invoke-Kerberoast` module to bruteforce passwords and retrieve encrypted service tickets.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)

During [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0004), threat actors used C2 servers managed through [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183).(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)
(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)
(Citation: Cisco Talos Avos Jun 2022)
During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries utilized [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) nodes for C2.(Citation: CERT Polska)
(Citation: CISA Iran Albanian Attacks September 2022)(Citation: Microsoft Albanian Government Attacks September 2022)

During [C0017](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0017), [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used multiple [dsquery](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0105) commands to enumerate various Active Directory objects within a compromised environment.(Citation: Mandiant APT41)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used [Arp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0099) to write to a file named outlog.txt, including: currently running processes, network connections, routing tables, ARP cache, and the contents of user directories.(Citation: CERT Polska)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [dsquery](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0105) to retrieve all subnets in the Active Directory.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
(Citation: Cisco Talos Avos Jun 2022)(Citation: Costa AvosLocker May 2022)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries had utilized [Ping](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0097) to enumerate network devices.(Citation: CERT Polska)
(Citation: Microsoft 365 Defender Solorigate)(Citation: CrowdStrike StellarParticle January 2022)
During [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0004), threat actors used [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029).(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)

During [C0017](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0017), [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) to execute the `lsadump::sam` command on dumped registry hives to obtain locally stored credentials and NTLM hashes.(Citation: Mandiant APT41)
(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
(Citation: Cybereason OperationCuckooBees May 2022)

[Water Curupira Pikabot Distribution](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0037) distributed [Pikabot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1145) as an initial access mechanism.(Citation: TrendMicro Pikabot 2024)

During [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060), [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) used [Arp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0099) for discovery.(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha Anel NOV 2024)

[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
[APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051)(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)
(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)
(Citation: McAfee Honeybee)
(Citation: Microsoft Analyzing Solorigate Dec 2020)(Citation: CrowdStrike StellarParticle January 2022)
(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory SVR TTP May 2021)
During [Night Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0002), threat actors used [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) to remotely execute droppers.(Citation: McAfee Night Dragon)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) to interact with other systems inside the internal network.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
(Citation: McAfee Honeybee)

During [C0017](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0017), [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) issued [Ping](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0097) commands to trigger DNS resolutions for data exfiltration, where the output of a reconnaissance command was prepended to subdomains within [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096)'s Cloudflare C2 infrastructure.(Citation: Mandiant APT41)

During [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), threat actors used `smbexec.py` and `psexec.py` from [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) for lateral movement.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used [Tasklist](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0057) for reconnaissance activities running `cmd.exe /c "tasklist > C:\Windows\TEMP\outlog.txt && netstat -nao >> C:\Windows\TEMP\outlog.txt && netstat -r >> C:\Windows\TEMP\ outlog.txt && arp -a >> C:\Windows\TEMP\outlog.txt && dir /s /b C:\ Users >> C:\Windows\TEMP\outlog.txt`.(Citation: CERT Polska)
(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)

During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used [netstat](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0104) to conduct reconnaissance, running `C:\Windows\TEMP\outlog.txt && netstat -nao`.(Citation: CERT Polska)
(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)
During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) for lateral movement.(Citation: CERT Polska)
(Citation: CISA Iran Albanian Attacks September 2022)

For [Operation Ghost](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0023), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) used [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) for lateral movement on compromised networks.(Citation: ESET Dukes October 2019)
(Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge Part 2 January 2024)

During [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060), [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) used [Rubeus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1071).(Citation: ESET MirrorFace 2025)

During [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060), [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) used [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144).(Citation: ESET MirrorFace 2025)
